governance.feature_grain: inspection interval, unless explicitly stated otherwise
governance.point_in_time_rule: A feature may use only source facts with business time at or before its score/interval end time.
governance.blocked_value_rule: A BLOCKED feature must not be materialised as a numerical estimate or silently imputed.
governance.source_of_truth: Feature readiness is governed by this specification; physical-distance policy is docs/rtis_distance_semantics.md.

status_definitions.READY: Released and permitted in an approved product at the stated grain and caveats.
status_definitions.READY_WITH_CAVEAT: Released factual context; use is limited by an explicit semantic caveat.
status_definitions.READY_FOR_MATERIALISATION: Verified source and formula exist, but no product column has yet been released.
status_definitions.PENDING: Expected feature with a known implementation or validation task remaining.
status_definitions.BLOCKED: Must not be calculated until named dependencies are approved.
status_definitions.FUTURE: Requires a source or capability not presently available.

features.name: Inspection interval duration
features.engineering_meaning: Elapsed calendar time between two attributable wheelset/equipment measurements.
features.formula: (interval_end_timestamp - interval_start_timestamp) / 86,400 seconds
features.consumer_limit: Duration is not evidence of locomotive operation or distance.

features.name: Point-in-time assignment quality
features.engineering_meaning: Whether a measurement has exactly one effective-dated equipment-to-locomotive assignment.
features.formula: timeline_quality_tier emitted by Business Truth v1.0
validation_rules: Gold B requires exactly one valid assignment interval
Gold C records are excluded from high-confidence features
features.consumer_limit: wsmEquipmentId remains equipment/wheelset-candidate identity pending business-semantic confirmation.

features.name: Raw endpoint diameter change
features.grain: one inspection interval and measured side
features.engineering_meaning: Observed endpoint difference in the recorded diameter field; not yet an approved wear measure.
features.formula: interval_end_wsmDiaN - interval_start_wsmDiaN
features.unit: source measurement unit, engineering unit confirmation pending
validation_rules: retain sign and do not clip
features.consumer_limit: Do not label as wear or use as a health score until measurement units, turning and replacement semantics are approved.

features.name: RTIS source-event count
features.engineering_meaning: Count of timestamped records from the RTIS emergency-event source in the interval.
features.formula: COUNT(DISTINCT IrledId WHERE start < EVENT_TRANSMISSION_TIME <= end AND normalised LOCO_NO matches)
features.consumer_limit: Event-code engineering meaning is pending; do not claim an individual code proves braking or a wheel mechanism.

features.name: Maintenance job-card creation count
features.engineering_meaning: Number of job cards created for the assigned locomotive in the interval.
features.formula: COUNT(DISTINCT SejId WHERE start < SejCreatedOn <= end AND SejLocoId matches)
validation_rules: valid locomotive ID and creation timestamp
features.consumer_limit: Creation is not completion, effectiveness, wheel specificity, or a turning/replacement event.

features.name: RTIS reporting coverage
features.engineering_meaning: Share of interval days with one or more RTIS mileage-source reports.
features.formula: 100 * distinct RTIS report dates in interval / interval_days
validation_rules: dates must be source report dates
features.consumer_limit: Coverage measures reporting presence only; it is not a measure of kilometres, movement, route coverage or utilisation.

features.name: Static locomotive axle-load configuration
features.engineering_meaning: Configured static axle load of the locomotive class, not hauled-train or dynamic load.
features.formula: LocoTypes.LotAxelLoad joined via LocoMaster.LomType
features.unit: source unit; engineering confirmation required before display
features.consumer_limit: Never represent as time-varying hauled-train load or wheel-rail contact load.

features.name: Wheel position (1-12)
features.engineering_meaning: Physical wheel position on the locomotive, resolved from wheelset position and end type via the formation template.
features.formula: WheelFormationTemplates.WftWheelPos joined on (wsmWheelSetPosition, wsmW1EndType)
features.consumer_limit: Uses the WAP7 formation template; other locomotive types require their own template rows.

features.name: Axle / wheelset position
features.engineering_meaning: Wheelset (axle) position on the locomotive as recorded on the endpoint measurement.
features.formula: wsmWheelSetPosition at interval end
features.consumer_limit: Position as recorded; wheelset reassignment across locomotives is not inferred here.

features.name: Wheel inspection count
features.grain: one wheel register record, up to and including interval end
features.engineering_meaning: Number of wheel measurements recorded for the same wheel register id up to the interval end.
features.formula: COUNT(WheelSetMeasurements rows with same wsmWRId AND wsmUpdatedOn <= interval_end_timestamp)
features.consumer_limit: Count of recorded inspections; not evidence of maintenance quality or completion.

features.name: Wheel profile (2-class)
features.grain: wheel register record / inherited by interval
features.engineering_meaning: Current wheel profile class (1/2) recorded on the wheel register for the endpoint wheel.
features.formula: LocoWheelRegister.LwrWheelProfile
validation_rules: register join wsmWRId=LwrId on WAP7 intervals matches 99.98% (2026-08-03)
features.consumer_limit: Two-class source profile; meaning of each class requires domain confirmation. 25% of intervals have no profile recorded.

features.name: Wheel maintenance schedule
features.grain: wheel register record / inherited by interval
features.engineering_meaning: Schedule id recorded against the wheel register for the endpoint wheel.
features.formula: LocoWheelRegister.LwrScheduleId
validation_rules: register join wsmWRId=LwrId on WAP7 intervals matches 99.98% (2026-08-03)
schedule code value mapped to schedule type
features.consumer_limit: Recorded schedule context; not a maintenance completion or effectiveness signal.

features.name: Home shed
features.grain: locomotive, latest at or before interval end
features.engineering_meaning: Home shed of the locomotive as recorded in the daily overdue ledger at interval end.
features.formula: DailyOverdueLocoCount.HomeShed latest per locomotive with EntryDate <= interval_end_timestamp
validation_rules: EntryDate at or before interval end
features.consumer_limit: The overdue ledger begins 2024-12-03; earlier intervals have no shed value. Shed is assignment context, not movement evidence.

features.name: Defect zone
features.grain: locomotive, latest at or before interval end
features.engineering_meaning: Zone recorded against the most recent locomotive defect occurrence at or before interval end.
features.formula: OnlineDefects_LogHistory.OldZone latest per OldLocoId with OldDateOccurance <= interval_end_timestamp
validation_rules: occurrence date at or before interval end
features.consumer_limit: Zone inferred from defect records; absence of a defect does not mean absence of zone coverage. 26% of intervals have no zone.

features.name: Defect division
features.grain: locomotive, latest at or before interval end
features.engineering_meaning: Division recorded against the most recent locomotive defect occurrence at or before interval end.
features.formula: OnlineDefects_LogHistory.OldDivision latest per OldLocoId with OldDateOccurance <= interval_end_timestamp
validation_rules: occurrence date at or before interval end
features.consumer_limit: Division inferred from defect records; not a route-reconstruction source.

features.name: Wheel age proxy (days, EmrDoR-anchored)
features.grain: wheelset equipment, state at interval end
features.engineering_meaning: Days since the wheel's authoritative age date: EquipmentMasterRegister.EmrDoR (in-service date, near manufacture) preferred, falling back to EmrDoM (manufacture) then wsmProvDate (provision/fit date).
features.formula: interval_end_timestamp - cascade[EmrDoR per wsmEquipmentId -> EmrDoM -> wsmProvDate at interval end]; date source recorded in wheel_age_date_source
validation_rules: age date at or before interval end
EmrDoR usable on 58.4% of wheelsets; EmrDoM on 11.9%; wsmProvDate fallback 35.0% (Q6)
date source column populated on every non-null age
features.consumer_limit: Proxy for wheel age, not operating age or distance. wsmProvDate fallback lags manufacture by ~94 days median (fit date, not manufacture). LocoEquipmentChangeRegister dates are loco-level and must not be used per wheel (Q6).

features.name: Raw turning indicator
features.engineering_meaning: Turning flag recorded at the interval-end wheel measurement; 1 = reprofiling/turning performed at or near that measurement (owner-confirmed 2026-08-03, Q1).
features.formula: wsmturning1 at the interval-end measurement
validation_rules: flag refers to the endpoint measurement only
LwrTurningType must NOT be used as a turning event (Q3: it is a post-turning inspection outcome; 92.5% of its rows are un-flagged)
features.consumer_limit: Does not assert the wheel is fully restored or that an interval contained only one turning event. Minor turning undercount possible (Q2 residual ~0.6% of pairs); acceptable for a feature, not for a true turning-count label.

features.name: Days since last wheel turning
features.grain: wheelset equipment, state at interval end
features.engineering_meaning: Calendar days since the most recent wsmturning=1 measurement on the same wheelset equipment identity, at or before the interval end.
features.formula: interval_end_timestamp - MAX(wsmUpdatedOn WHERE wsmEquipmentId = interval-end equipment AND wsmturning1 = 1 AND wsmUpdatedOn <= interval_end_timestamp)
validation_rules: no turning event in history -> null
features.consumer_limit: Not a true turning-count label: the flag may undercount events by a small residual (~0.6% of pairs, Q2). Do not combine with LwrTurningType (Q3).

features.name: Engineering wear rate per day
features.grain: one measurement side and inspection interval
features.engineering_meaning: Physical material loss rate across a validated non-intervened interval.
features.formula: approved material-loss measure / interval_days
features.consumer_limit: No numerical output or training label is permitted.

features.name: Physical distance travelled
features.engineering_meaning: Physical locomotive travel attributable to the interval.
features.formula: owner-approved (2026-08-05) daily aggregation: deduped per-loco per-day SUM of division km with combined outlier rejection (07_safe_rtis_daily_aggregation.py), summed over interval (start, end]
validation_rules: duplicate/reload and reset rule (business-key dedupe + outlier rejection)
features.consumer_limit: Approved for materialisation as interval_distance_km in model_datasets/v2. The legacy experimental column interval_distance_km_experimental remains un-renamed.

features.name: Engineering wear rate per kilometre
features.grain: one measurement side and inspection interval
features.engineering_meaning: Material loss normalised by attributable physical travel.
features.formula: approved material-loss measure / interval_distance_km
features.consumer_limit: No numerical output or training label is permitted.

features.name: Historical weather exposure
features.engineering_meaning: Aggregated weather context over validated time/location observations.
features.formula: provider-defined aggregation of temperature, precipitation and humidity over validated movement locations/times
features.consumer_limit: Supporting context only; never a causal conclusion.

features.name: Track curve/gradient severity
features.engineering_meaning: Route-segment physical severity based on authoritative curvature and gradient.
features.formula: distance-weighted approved curve/gradient function over mapped track segments
dependencies: released interval distance or segment exposure rule
features.consumer_limit: Open/GIS data may support research only until engineering validation.

features.name: Explainable wheel health index
features.engineering_meaning: Engineering-approved summary of measured geometry, degradation and maintenance state.
features.formula: versioned rule or calibrated model over released State, Degradation and Maintenance features
features.consumer_limit: No numerical output is permitted until the dependencies are released. It is not a prediction, maintenance directive or failure diagnosis.
